title: Not impressed
text: Not impressed. The quality of these pans is severely lacking. While heating up, you can hear pinging, as if the layers of the metal are delaminating. While cooking, there are hot spots making the cooking uneven, and prone to burning the food in places. Over all, I am very unhappy with this. Very disappointing.
